"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Workers with disabilities were fired at almost two times the rate of workers without disabilities during Donald Trump's presidency.",

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Donald Trump called for benefit cutbacks for Social Security Disability Insurance.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Donald Trump called to cut funding for special education grants.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Donald Trump called to eliminate federal funding for the Special Olympics.",

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Donald Trump rescinded guidance protecting students with disabilities.",
